This method differs from the previous approach by:

2. Mathematical specification
The optimization will occur in a space of sequences of fixed length L=512. Each sequence is represented as a vector of non-negative floats a[0..L-1].

The objective function is defined as using `evaluate_sequence` which computes:
score = 2 * L * (max(b_sequence) + 1e-12) / (float(sum(a))+1e-12)**2
Where b_sequence = linear convolution(a, a) - min linear convolution(a, a) (to make max position more stable)

All sequences will be normalized to have sum >0.01 before evaluation.

Operations will be performed via the evaluate_sequence function for simplicity and consistency, though this could introduce evaluation overhead.
